number_line: Nearly sixty pounds, through the crew lane.
gotcha: Picked for a search, she kicked off her heels and ran.
person_line: Marsha Gay Reynolds. Cabin crew. The next day, she still flew home.
consequence_line: She pleaded guilty, then testified. Her supplier got nearly 14 years; she got time served.
person_first: A flight attendant ran from her own suitcase.
